description: This file contains functions related to dynamic module reloading, environment configuration, and Triton kernel compilation management within the PyTorch _inductor runtime. It includes utility functions for managing environment variables, reloading modules, and compiling Triton kernels with timing and logging.

methods.name: ModuleType _reload_python_module( key: str, path: str, set_sys_modules: bool = True )
methods.description: Reloads a Python module from a specified file path, optionally updating sys.modules.

methods.name: None _set_triton_ptxas_path()
methods.description: Sets the environment variable TRITON_PTXAS_PATH if not already set, based on a heuristically determined path.

methods.name: tuple[CachingAutotuner,int] _worker_compile_triton( load_kernel: Callable[[], CachingAutotuner], extra_env: dict[str, str], extra_config: dict[str, Any], )
methods.description: Handles the compilation of a Triton kernel with timing, environment setup, and logging.
